ruling.recommended_action: Close the case; note the RD-4(b) traffic band evidence was corroborative only (band 4 is not band 1–2) and the segment is exempted by rider consent under RD-5.

segment_findings.reason: Driver asked at 10:01 whether he could go round via Halus Link (F7) and the rider's own timestamped reply 'Sure, go ahead' (F8, F9) precedes the segment start (10:04), naming the route the segment implements — consent before the detour under RD-5, so this segment is not a detour (RD-3(a) route request by rider). RD-4 is not needed: F13 shows no incident on the optimal route, and the band 4 speeds (F11, F12) are not band 1–2 and are corroborative only.

rejected_claims.reason: RydeX is a fixed-quote service; billed distance 9.9 km equals the optimal route (F4) and the fare contains only published components (F6), so the extra 1.8 km (F1) produced no charge. RD-2 non-metered branch yields $0 refundable.
No incident on the optimal route (F13) and only band 4 speeds recorded (F11, F12), which cannot exempt under RD-4; the exemption here rests on rider consent (RD-5), not on traffic.
